{{Quote|Bayyaaa!|Gran greeting meaning "I see you!"|audio=GranGreetings-JJTM.flac|<ref name="JJTM">''[[Star Wars Episode I: Junior Jedi Training Manual]]''</ref>}}
'''Gran''' was the language of the [[Gran/Legends|Grans]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. It was also exported to Gran colonies such as [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and [[Stend IV]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

Many Grans learned to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. However, they also tried to make their servants, such as the [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]], learn Gran language. The language had a written form.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

==Known words==
*'''Bayyaaa''' 'Greetings!' (literally 'I see you!')<ref name="JJTM" />
*'''Ayyabaa''' 'See you soon!'<ref name="JJTM" />
